reconstruction_contract: Authenticate original generation/epoch/plane/Discovery/construction/source-only calibration and bounded descriptors without opening old root/membership. Read exactly U fixed LE-u32 + FP16 records, SHA every leaf byte, exact EOF/length, finite halves, complete unique in-range IDs; scatter unchanged original bits in unit-ID order into literal BORSUCP1 header, zero reserved word; require whole approved construction SHA.
parity_contract: Authenticate whole old root/member/leaves by original authority before reading old limit80..88. Public admit + actual current radial build at unchanged old limit, separate cumulative experiment admission. Fully validate/open only generated BORSUSR3. Stream exact membership/payload and equal root length/every byte except fixed literal BORSUSR2->BORSUSR3 at0..8 and LE0->LE1 at88..92. Any other delta/unsupported limit INVALID. No patched proof or old serving decoder.
publication_contract: NEW directory via anchored mkdirat; CREATE|EXCL|NOFOLLOW files; descriptor/content readback, input/output/directory identity rechecks through all syncs. Seal receipt last through existing owned-descriptor INVALID cleanup on sync/recheck failure. Partial raw outputs may remain after refusal; never consumable success without successful original terminal receipt. File and receipt sync success additionally requires full post-write/pre-sync FileIdentity to remain unchanged after callback, including mtime/ctime; byte-identical unsynced rewrites refuse publication.
